# The Pharmaceutical Journal

> > The official journal of the Royal Pharmaceutical Society (RPS), providing pharmacy news, clinical guidance, practice updates, and professional resources for pharmacists across the UK.

The Pharmaceutical Journal serves as the leading publication for pharmacy professionals, covering community pharmacy practice, NHS developments, regulatory updates from the GPhC, clinical guidelines, and RPS governance including elections for the English Pharmacy Board. The journal features research articles, podcast transcriptions (The PJ Pod), and educational content on topics ranging from chronic disease management to self-care and OTC medicines.

## Key Topics

- Royal Pharmaceutical Society (RPS)
- Community pharmacy practice
- NHS England pharmacy services
- General Pharmaceutical Council (GPhC) regulation
- English Pharmacy Board elections
- Clinical guidelines and evidence-based practice
- Self-care and OTC medicines
- Pharmacy leadership and governance
- Chronic disease management (heart failure, migraine)
- Pain management and analgesics
- Pharmaceutical education and CPD
- Pharmacy workforce and professional development
- The PJ Pod (pharmacy podcast)
- UK pharmacy news and policy
